summary: The operator's controller start message moves out of session_start: `legion controller start` appends the positional word `/legion-controller-start`, Oh My Pi runs it as its first command-line prompt after startup and after the TUI listens (omp main.ts:815-821), and pi-legion's new extension command of that name sends LEGION_CONTROLLER_START_MESSAGE. A process-wide start mark in the pi-shared interface (version 4) makes pi-envoy's startup wake (PR #2278) wait for the start turn and then wake for the startup cards after it; the daemon API contract is bumped as the CLI/plugin skew guard, and `legion controller start` refuses a non-terminal stdin before the mint.
dependencies: PR #2278 (dispatch://INFRA-497, branch legion/INFRA-497) must merge to main before task 5 (pi-envoy deferral); bring main into legion/INFRA-511 then (architect asked to confirm).
tasks: 1. Dependency: tasks 2-4 and 6-8 start on main; task 5 after #2278 merges and main is brought in.

2. Interactive PTY runner in packages/pi-shared/test/omp-harness.ts (Bun.Terminal, Bun 1.3.14; OMP_SKIP_SETUP=1; stand-in gateway with held replies, stand-in daemon GET /legion/v1/state + controller claims/register + controller grant, stand-in listener, real NATS via LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL). Run it at the base commit with today's argv and record what the screen shows while the start turn's request is held (start message and busy indicator shown?, typed text + Enter taken?, Esc aborts?) in the PR body and implement handoff.

3. CLI packages/daemon/cmd/legion/controller.go: append positional `/legion-controller-start` (Go constant beside daemon.ControllerStartMessage) after --append-system-prompt; refuse a stdin that is not a terminal after the operator-token-file check and before the probe and mint (test seam per the DI convention); update comments controller.go:92-95, 235-239, 272-274 and internal/daemon/controller.go:17-25.

4. pi-legion + pi-shared: controller-session.ts keeps the session_start claim from sending; at today's send point it records the start as due and sets envoyPluginInterface().startupTurn = {session, sentAt: undefined}; keeps the in-flight claim promise. extensions/legion.ts registers `legion-controller-start` with the decision table in plan.md (await in-flight claim; due and unsent: sendUserMessage when idle, deliverAs followUp when a turn runs, record sent, stamp sentAt; claim failed before due: ui.notify warning naming /legion-claim-controller; otherwise notify nothing to send). Claims after startup (/legion-claim-controller, reclaimAfterSessionChange) keep today's direct send when nothing was sent. agent_start whose session id equals the mark's clears it; session_shutdown clears it. pi-types.ts: sendUserMessage deliverAs 'followUp', CommandContext isIdle?. interface.ts: startupTurn record, ENVOY_PLUGIN_INTERFACE_VERSION 3 -> 4.

5. pi-envoy extensions/envoy.ts (on #2278): an idle fold check while the mark names its own session and is not past STARTUP_TURN_CAP_MS (30 s) from sentAt (no cap while sentAt is unset) keeps startupPhase, sends no wake, records the seen startup cards as owed; with sentAt set it re-arms at the cap. After the start turn's agent_end the check wakes for the owed cards whether or not a reply follows them. A mark past the cap is ignored.

6. Daemon API contract to the next free number (40 unless main took it): internal/api/version.go entry with the collision note, contracts/fixtures/daemon-api/version.json, pi-legion and claude-envoy package.json, every site the bump procedure names (grep daemonApiVersion / DaemonAPIVersion / the old number, packages/contracts/AGENTS.md); promptreferences_omp_test.go spells interface version 4.

7. Tests (acceptance table) and CI: pi-legion job in .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml:584 gets the NATS service and LEGION_TEST_NATS_URL; the pi_legion path filter (:357) adds packages/pi-envoy/**.

8. Docs and changelogs: packages/pi-legion/AGENTS.md:347-352 (and the LEGION-392 reason), packages/pi-envoy/AGENTS.md, packages/pi-shared/AGENTS.md (version 4, startupTurn), docs/kubernetes.md:6182-6187, scripts/e2e/README.md:1639 and :1663-1664, comments in scripts/e2e/controller-start-tmux.sh:150-151 and stage4b-sandbox-tree.sh:5429-5444, [Unreleased] in pi-legion, pi-envoy and claude-envoy CHANGELOGs, root AGENTS.md `legion controller start` line if it describes the start message.

decisions: A person typing before the command runs takes the first turn; the start message follows as a follow-up of that turn. The spec orders the start message ahead of Envoy cards and Legion notices, not ahead of a person.
Startup cards are in the start turn's context and also get their own wake after it (the spec: the wake must not take the first turn ahead of the start message).
The daemon API contract bump is the repository's CLI/plugin skew guard (version.go 36-39 bumped the same way); a deployment rolls daemon, worker image and plugins together for it.

Rejected: a witness message plus timer in pi-legion (can fire before InteractiveMode's #subscribeToAgent, interactive-mode.ts:2458-2498, and races pi-envoy's wake timer); the start-message text as the positional word (sent even when the claim failed; session.prompt raises no input event).
reportedToArchitect: The daemon-launched controller (out of scope per the spec): since #2278 its start message, an RPC prompt after claims/ready (internal/daemon/controller.go:138-151), can lose the first turn to a startup card's wake timer because RPC mode reads no input until startup returns; on main before #2278 a startup card already ran its turn inside the drain ahead of it. Unverified on a binary; the same mark set at ready would cover it.

findings.finding: 1. CLI and pi-legion coupled through the new positional word with no skew check (new CLI + old plugin sends the word to the model as text; old CLI + new plugin never sends the start).
findings.answer: Daemon API contract bump (design item 6, task 6, A8): the controller probe refuses a pi-legion at another contract before the mint, both directions.

findings.finding: 2. The startup mark may never clear (no positional word, claim past the 30 s handler timeout, send failing before agent_start, a subagent's agent_start, /new before the command).
findings.answer: Contract bump removes the no-word case; the command awaits an in-flight claim; the mark clears only on its own session's agent_start and on session_shutdown; pi-envoy ignores a mark more than 30 s past its sentAt and re-arms at the cap; a session change gives pi-envoy another session id (A10).

findings.finding: 3. Command behaviour undefined for a claim in flight, failed before or after the mark.
findings.answer: Decision table in plan.md design item 2 covering in-flight, due-and-unsent (including a later step that threw, as legion.test.ts:2564 keeps), failed before due, already sent / takeover / none.

findings.finding: 4. Input typed before the positional command takes the first turn; E2 widens that window.
findings.answer: Decision: a person's own turn may come first; the start message then goes as a followUp of that turn; recorded in Decisions.

findings.finding: 5. Non-terminal stdin turns the positional word into a headless print-mode run after the mint.
findings.answer: legion controller start refuses a non-terminal stdin before the probe and the mint (design item 7, A9), after the token-file check so controller-start-tmux.sh:270 is unchanged.

findings.finding: 6. 'Ahead of any card' has two readings.
findings.answer: Reading B: startup cards are owed their own wake after the start turn, whether or not a reply follows them (design item 5, A6).

findings.finding: 7. Daemon-launched controller's first turn under #2278 is ambiguous.
findings.answer: Out of scope per the spec ('behave as they do today'); reported to the architect with the evidence and a proposed fix.

findings.finding: 8. Acceptance criteria had no machine-checkable outputs; test profile must skip the setup wizard; no TS PTY harness; pi-legion CI job has no NATS.
findings.answer: Acceptance table A1-A12 with concrete observables; OMP_SKIP_SETUP=1 (tui/src/setup/wizard.ts:51); PTY runner via Bun.Terminal added to omp-harness.ts (task 2); NATS service and path filter in CI (task 7); A6 names the hold point.

findings.finding: 9. Two line references wrong (controller_test.go :827 should be :835; legion.test.ts list missed :2608).
findings.answer: Corrected in plan.md (A11 :835; 2608 in the reworked tests).

findings.finding: 10. Unverified draft claims (Bun.Terminal, no extension event after the wait, sendUserMessage triggerTurn, notices via the same deliver).
findings.answer: Verified: .bun-version 1.3.14 and `typeof Bun.Terminal` is 'function' in this pod; sendUserMessage options confirmed by the analyst; the plan reviewer traced the controller-topic notice through envoy.ts subscribeNotice. The no-event claim stays the INFRA-497 implementer's reading, and the design does not depend on it.

findings.finding: 11. Session title from the positional word: not a gap.
findings.answer: No change needed; pi-legion titles the session in session_start and auto-title skips a named session.

specDepartures.spec: The spec's scope is pi-legion's start-message send (controller-session.ts:183) and the real-binary proof; it names no CLI or contract change.
specDepartures.plan: `legion controller start` appends the positional word `/legion-controller-start`, and the daemon API contract is bumped so the controller probe refuses a pi-legion of another release before the mint.
specDepartures.evidence: The extension API has no event after the startup wait, and a pi-legion timer can fire before InteractiveMode subscribes to agent events (omp interactive-mode.ts:2458-2498, event-controller.ts:800-813); Oh My Pi's command-line prompts run after startup and after the TUI listens (omp main.ts:815-825). The word couples the CLI and pi-legion; the probe compares only daemonApiVersion (bootgate.go:955-1000).

outcome.scope: Adds a change to the legion CLI (controller.go) and a daemon API contract bump; a deployment rolls daemon, worker image and plugins together for it.

specDepartures.spec: legion controller start is unchanged apart from the start message.
specDepartures.plan: `legion controller start` refuses a stdin that is not a terminal, before the probe and the mint.
specDepartures.evidence: With a positional word and a non-terminal stdin Oh My Pi runs print mode (omp main.ts:1886-1889) and would run a headless start turn after the mint revoked the running controller; today it exits (exitWithoutTerminal).

outcome.scope: A new refusal in legion controller start for a non-terminal stdin.
